testcase.name: Scenario: Transfer a selected command after reversing the source list: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:616:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Transfer a selected command after reversing the source list ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the Tools ribbon visible ✔ And the Ribbon customization dialog shows All Commands in ascending order for an empty Part Tools custom panel ✔ When the user selects "2D Sketches" in the available command list ✔ And the user clicks the available command list Name header ✔ Then the visible source list begins with the separator and descending Zoom commands ✔ And the add transfer button remains enabled ✔ When the user clicks the add transfer button ✔ Then "2D Sketches" appears in the custom panel list ✔ And the target indicates a pending change ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And no User Commands panel is displayed on the Tools ribbon
